name: Youngstown
takeaway: Youngstown's Dynegy aggregation contract ends at the June 2026 meter read — no announced renewal. Accounts are about to revert to Ohio Edison standard. This is the hottest individual agg in the valley right now.
hook: Youngstown's Dynegy contract is ending at the June meter read and there's no renewal announcement. Are those accounts going back to Ohio Edison standard? That's a 9.38-cent conversation happening right now.
notes: Dynegy program through June 2026 meter read. No confirmed successor program as of June 2026. Distinct from Mahoning County program (which covers unincorporated areas at different rate).

name: Trumbull County
takeaway: County program moved from 7.90¢ to 10.14¢; historical 4.53¢ context makes the pain sharper.
hook: Did you see where the county program landed? It moved into the 10¢ range.
notes: County program excludes cities/villages plus Brookfield and Liberty townships.

name: Mahoning County
takeaway: County aggregation is now above Trumbull at 10.59¢; strong double-digit pain story.
hook: Mahoning County landed over ten and a half cents.
notes: County-level program does not mean every address in Mahoning County is eligible.

name: Warren City
takeaway: City of Warren has no clean aggregation anchor; use supplier/utility discovery.
hook: Are you guys on a supplier right now or just riding utility?
notes: Surrounding Trumbull townships may have county aggregation.

name: Sebring
takeaway: Municipal electric village, but outer commercial addresses may be Ohio Edison.
hook: Verify from bill before treating it as municipal or Ohio Edison.
notes: 1005 Lake Park Blvd likely leans Ohio Edison but must be verified.

name: Austintown Township
takeaway: Austintown Township is the commercial core of the Youngstown metro — Mahoning Ave, US-224 corridor. Falls under the Mahoning County Dynegy program at 10.59¢. Rate is already elevated; confirm exact term end.
hook: Austintown is on the Mahoning County aggregation at 10.59¢ — that's one of the highest rates in the valley right now. Are your accounts there on the county program or do they have their own deal?
notes: Austintown Township is the largest unincorporated community in Mahoning County (~35,000 residents) and the dominant commercial strip in the metro area (Mahoning Ave, US-224, Belmont Ave corridors). Falls under Mahoning County aggregation territory (Dynegy). Rate and term end date tied to Mahoning County program — verify township's independent opt-in status separately from county program. Distinct from Youngstown city program (Dynegy 7.99¢, expired June 2026). Ohio Edison territory.
